== Trivia ==
* This shout is a reference to King Arthur's quote from [[w:Monty Python and the Holy Grail|Monty Python and the Holy Grail]]. Arthur shouts this at the [[w:Black Knight (Monty Python)|Black Knight]] after he has cut off both the knight's arms.
* This is one of nine elite skills seen in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]] in {{reforgedmode}}, where it is used by [[Grawl Fighter]]s. The other eight are [[Barrage]], [[Bull's Charge]], [[Earth Shaker]], [[Elemental Attunement]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Hundred Blades]], [[Plague Signet]], and [[Ward Against Harm]].
